description: Import mpoints from zones or balls. Note A model domain must be specified prior to importing mpoints.

keywords.name: from-balls
keywords.description: Create a single mpoint for each ball. The mpoint position, volume, ID and group(s) are set equal to that of the ball. The optional delete keyword, deletes the balls after the import. Dropped from the 9.8 manual page and the installed command index, but `mpoint import ?` on MPoint3D 9.8.54 still lists it.

keywords.name: from-zones
keywords.description: Import mpoints from zones. By default an mpoint is created for each of the zone gridpoints, i.e., {4 in 2D; 8 in 3D} for {quadrilateral in 2D; hexahedral in 3D} zones, and {3 in 2D; 4 and 5 in 3D} for {triangular in 2D; tetrahedral and pyramid in 3D} zones. The mpoint volume is always set equal to the zone volume divided by the number of mpoints created per zone. By default, the mpoint density, constitutive model (including all of its property values), extra variables, and zone fluid properties are set equal to those of the zone. All of the zone groups are also assigned to the mpoint. The mpoint velocity, displacement, pore pressure and stress are obtained by linear interpolation of the gridpoints values. The gridpoint stress is defined as the volume average of the stress in all the zones connected to the gridpoint. Note Only zone extra variables are transferred to material points; gridpoint extra variables are not transferred.

keywords.name: kwd:keep
keywords.description: Keep the zones after the import. By default zones are deleted.

keywords.name: kwd:number
keywords.description: Control the number of mpoints created per zone. The behavior depends on the zone type {quadrilateral in 2D; hexahedral in 3D} or {triangular in 2D; tetrahedral in 3D} - see Figures 1 and 2 for details. The default value is 2 (one mpoint per gridpoint for all zone types).

keywords.name: kwd:skip
keywords.description: Skip importing the specified information from zones.

keywords.name: kwd:all
keywords.description: Do not import any information from zones.

keywords.name: kwd:cmodel
keywords.description: Do not set the mpoint constitutive model and its properties.

keywords.name: kwd:density
keywords.description: Do not set the mpoint density.

keywords.name: kwd:displacement
keywords.description: Do not set the mpoint displacement.

keywords.name: kwd:extra
keywords.description: Do not set the mpoint extra variables.

keywords.name: kwd:fluid
keywords.description: Do not set any of the mpoint fluid properties, including the pore-pressure.

keywords.name: kwd:group
keywords.description: Do not set the mpoint group(s).

keywords.name: kwd:stress
keywords.description: Do not set the mpoint stress.

keywords.name: kwd:velocity
keywords.description: Do not set the mpoint velocity.

figure_reference.note: This command embeds reference figures that are not captured in this text corpus. Figures are PNGs under <doc-root>/_images/ (doc-root sits beside the engine install, e.g. C:/Program Files/Itasca/<product>/exe64/doc); read them directly.
